statement.notes: MAPPING NOTES: 1) 'investment_in_securities' mapped to the sum of 'Short-term investments' and 'Equity and other investments' (since both are typical security investments for a tech company). 2) 'accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities' mapped to the sum of 'Accounts payable' and 'Other current liabilities' (as the schema field appears to combine these concepts). 3) 'advance_payments_from_sales' mapped to the sum of 'Short-term unearned revenue' and 'Long-term unearned revenue' (as unearned revenue represents payments received for future services). 4) 'total_non_current_liabilities' calculated as the sum of all non-current liability line items: Long-term debt, Long-term income taxes, Long-term unearned revenue, Deferred income taxes, Operating lease liabilities, and Other long-term liabilities. 5) 'advance_payments_for_purchases' not found in statement; set to null. 6) 'cash' mapped to 'Cash and cash equivalents' only (excludes short-term investments).
